title: McMoneagle's JPL correspondence and life on Mars as an open secret
summary: Jesse Michels tells of McMoneagle's JPL correspondence and life on Mars as an open secret, about recent at Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's basically implying to me that it's an open secret at Jet Propulsion Lab that there was life on Mars

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he has been in contact with Joseph McMoneagle, a man who took part in a US government psychic spy programme. According to Michels, McMoneagle implied that at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's space probe centre in Pasadena, California, it is an open secret that there was once life on Mars. If true, scientists there would quietly know something the public has not been told.
